maria_eng: ack, seeing the same locally when pulling base image. investigating registry transient errors.
paul_release: tagging hold. Can we still make the change window at 16:00 UTC if this takes >1h? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

qa_sam: FYI smoke not started because build didn't produce artifact. If we can't get artifact soon we should pin to v1.11.4 for the scheduled rollout.

```
FAIL tests/test_kv_cache.py::TestKV::test_cache_eviction

```

qa_sam: flaky integration — we've seen this intermittently on xla-quantize branch. Might be a timing issue in teardown.
paul_release: given change window constraints, I'm proposing: pin staging to v1.11.4 for the 16:00 rollout, and create a hotfix branch for v1.12.0-rc3 integration flake. Any objections?
maria_eng: +1 to pin. I'll open PR to pin the release manifest to v1.11.4 and file the integration bug with logs.
oliver_ops: will mark the staging promotion on the calendar as "pinned to v1.11.4" and cancel the auto-promote workflow.

deploybot: action summary: HOLD promotion for v1.12.0-rc3 -> staging. Pin staging to v1.11.4. Created task: REL-1427 (integration flake on kv cache). Notifying infra.
paul_release: thanks — good catch everyone. We'll target a follow-up candidate after root cause. :thumbsup:
